purpose: Deterministic selection of ONE exact quote per (game_id, player_id, prop) for the PRIMARY market-superiority comparison. Frozen by general market liquidity/reputation BEFORE inspecting any candidate performance; must not be re-ordered to favor results.
selection_rule: For each (game_id, player_id, prop) at the decision-time snapshot, choose the exact Over/Under pair from the highest-priority sportsbook present (lowest rank). Deterministic tie-break: sportsbook name ascending, then earliest snapshot_time.
notes: All-books-pooled rows are permitted ONLY as SENSITIVITY_ANALYSIS, never as the primary proof dataset (pooling the same player outcome once per book overweights events with more book coverage).
